title: Chapter 1030 His Era Is Over
content:
Chapter 1030 His Era Is Over

In the spring of March of the second year of the Regency, Fusu once again stood on the shore of Xi'anping (Dandong).

Mazi water is still so clear and green, and when spring comes, groups of wild ducks swim on it.

No wonder Heifu said that it will be called "Yalu River" in the future.

This was the third time Fusu came to Xi'anping. The first time was on an expedition to Haidong under the orders of his father. Yang Duanhe died of illness in the old forests of Qianshan Mountain in Liaodong. He, a novice leader, encountered a mutiny here. It was really a mess. Fortunately, Hei Fu helped, otherwise it would have been even more ugly.

The second time, after witnessing the chaos in the Central Plains, he went through hardships and returned alone. With the name of Fusu, he led the Haidong garrison and made great achievements in the northeastern border of the empire!

Recalling the past, Fusu laughed dumbly: "We are both Fusu, but there is such a big gap between the front and back. No wonder everyone believed them when they said they were two people..."

Although Heifu’s conversation with Fusu at the foot of Wuzhou Mountain that day focused on the grievances and resentments between the Qin, Chu, Han and Xiongnu in the past few decades, it was enough to make Fusu return to Liaodong from Yan in the next few months. , repeated many times.

Because everything Heif said was so ridiculous.

He actually committed suicide after receiving a forged edict?

Fusu touched his neck.

"Is it because I'm born to be trusting of people and things?"

Or maybe, deep down, he is the kind of person who is willing to sacrifice himself for the sake of the peace of the world, and he has never changed?

Also, the Qin Dynasty, which Emperor Qin Shi Huang hoped to be passed down to generations, would actually die in the second generation? And it was destroyed by Xiang Yu of Chu State, and Guanzhong was destroyed in one day.

If my father knew about it, I don’t know what he would think.

And the final winner of this era is not Xiang Yu, but Fusu's subordinate, the arrogant and bearded old Liu Ji, who is full of dirty jokes. He is the final successor of Qin Shi Huangdi...

Fusu only thought it was funny. This was really a great irony.

But the strange thing is that this person was surrounded by Maodun in Baideng and signed a humiliating peace treaty...

As for Heifu? Originally, he was just a little Qin soldier with no name, who died in the first extermination of Chu!

The story is bizarre, with twists and turns that make people laugh and laugh, and are hard to believe.

This may be a story that Heifu made up to deceive Fusu.

"But I still choose to believe..."

No matter what, Fusu accepted such a "truth" and in exchange announced his own "lie".

"Your Majesty, the pontoon bridge across the river is ready."

Gao Cheng came over to report that this was the first time he had called me wrong. Fusu corrected him: "I have gone to the king's title and am no longer a king."

"Then, young master..."

"I have never been a prince, just a substitute." No matter how tempted his cronies were, Fusu insisted on this.

"What should I call it?"

"Let's just call him general, just like in the beginning."

"No wonder when he came to Haidong to summon us two years ago, he asked us to call him general instead of son..." Gao Cheng muttered. He already believed 80% of Fusu's story.

Gao Cheng was also one of the few subordinates who still decided to follow Fusu after he announced that he was "Fusu's substitute. After the prince's death, he will carry out his legacy and go to Haidong."

The rest of the people either left angrily or were disheartened. Most chose to stay in western Liaoning and eastern Liaoning and disband their armor and return to their fields.

The soldiers returned to their land. Heifu promised Liang Liao and You Beiping to rent free for three years in order to restore people's livelihood. This made the natives cheer. The already tired Haidong garrison also silently threw away their weapons and took away their belongings. The retirement money and silk and no need to fight are good news for everyone.

I believe that in the long-awaited stable life, they will soon forget themselves and the short-lived "fake Fusu".

"At most, when I have free time, I can say a few words of regret to my children and grandchildren."

Fusu secretly thought in his heart: "From now on, the world will only remember an eldest son who was ambitious, weak and incompetent, abandoned his wife, and died inexplicably..."

Gao Cheng, on the other hand, never gave up on him and said stubbornly: "Even if the general is not Fusu and deceived us, what happened in the past two years cannot be faked!"

"During the chaos in the Central Plains, when we and the Haidong garrison were hesitant, it was the general who showed up and gave us a backbone to prevent us from going into exile and becoming bandits. Is this false?"

"When Liaodong was invaded by King Donghu, it was the general who led us to fight head on and saved Liaodong. Is this false?"

"It is the general who has held up the sky in Liaodong and protected the peace of hundreds of thousands of people in the past two years! Is this also a lie!?"

Gao Cheng slammed his fist on his left chest: "Since everything is true and not false, even if you are not Master Fusu, we are willing to follow you!"

There were more than 3,000 people who had the same idea as Gao Cheng, and they followed him all the way to Xi'an Ping...

But this is far from the end.

Everyone will cross the Mazi River and once again pass through Jizi North Korea. Before summer, they will arrive at the "Hancheng" hundreds of miles away, where large armies once gathered, but today it has been abandoned.

There is the fiefdom of Gongsun Jun, the "Haidong Marquis".

This black man has countless conspiracies in his heart, and everything has been planned for a long time. When he announced "Fusu was dead" more than a year ago, he had made arrangements to add the title of "Haidong Marquis" to him, and Gongsun Jun inherited it.

Gongsun Jun will become the first border prince of the New Qin Dynasty, and he will be officially sealed! Divide the soil and fields to be dun, Zhu, Zong, Bu, Shi, prepare materials, regulations, lawsuits, and Yi utensils, all in Hancheng, govern the people of Mahan, Chenhan, and Bianhan, give orders to implement orders, and seal them in the sea East.

South of Korea, north of the sea, thousands of miles of mountains and rivers, are all the domain of the Marquis of Haidong!

The seal was not too generous, but it was far away. It was separated by a strip of water from the Central Plains, but it was far enough away from it. On the other side of the river was Jiaodong, which had a grudge against Fusu.

Fusu, on the other hand, had to bear a false name and serve as the first prime minister of the Haidong Kingdom...

Gongsun Jun will go to Haidong in the autumn season to reunite with Fusu and his son.

Fusu was looking forward to that day, hoping to see Xuangun Chixi, the little prince with a hook and a carved tin, as soon as possible.

But for a while, he couldn't figure out how to face the son who had been abandoned by him...

Should he recognize him as his father? Apologize to him.

Or should we continue that lie and, as the Prime Minister, help him wholeheartedly and silently protect him as he grows up?

How can we prevent the tragedy of father and son not believing from happening again?

Shaking his head, Fusu decided not to think about it for now. What he was more urgent about now was the moment to meet Liu Ji...

If there is a chance, Fusu will definitely take a good look at this person to see how virtuous and capable he is that he can win the world!

It's a pity that Lao Liu, who is a human being, can run faster than a rabbit.

Liu Ji, who was originally stationed in Liaodong, was horrified when he heard that Fusu had reconciled with Heifu. Before Fusu arrived, he took his wife, a member of the party, and more than a thousand people who were afraid of Heifu and ran away...

By the end of February, when Fusu arrived at the border between Qin and North Korea, he was sweating. Ji Zhun, the Marquis of North Korea, was waiting here. Facing Fusu's request for food from North Korea, Ji Zhun's face was filled with bitterness.

"Didn't we just go through it once last month?"

It turned out that when Liu Ji fled south in front of Fusu, he passed through North Korea and lied that he was a vanguard and follower of the army. He wanted to eat and drink. He even took away 300 Korean maids to warm his feet and recruited them. Three thousand Korean civilians accompanied him, and they also plundered many ships on the east coast, passed through Korea, and headed towards Benhan, the southernmost part of the peninsula...

Gao Chengyi was filled with indignation: "The general trusts Liu Ji so much, how dare he betray the general, we must catch this man!"

"Liu Ji is just afraid."

Fu Su laughed, and Hei Fu once joked that he would throw Liu Ji to Seoul and let this guy die there...

Maybe Liu Ji has foreseen his future? So he ran away early. Poor old Liu is still kept in the dark and doesn't understand why Hei Fu is always in trouble with him.

"Let him be."

Fusu thought for a long time and gave up Gao Cheng's suggestion of "pursuing Liu Ji".

"He and I are just wanderers who have left home, so why bother forcing each other."

Walking forward step by step, Peishui is right in front of you at the east end of Yan Great Wall.

"If we go further, we will leave Da Qin." Although North Korea is a vassal state of the Central Plains, it is different from counties and counties. Even the people who follow Fusu wholeheartedly hesitate a little before taking the step forward.

After all, this time, they will never come back!

Fusu remembered the last time he and Hei Fu met. The two of them said goodbye at Jieshi Mountain in Youbeiping County and made an agreement...

At that time, Fusu pointed to the east and promised: "In my life, I will die in the east and never return to the west!"

And Heifu pointed to the west and promised: "As long as I am here, Da Qin will be there."

"I will be a Qin official throughout my life, starting well and ending well!"

The look in his eyes was extremely sincere and didn't seem to be fake, but Fusu couldn't tell for sure.

"What will happen to the world after you and I die?" Fusu asked unwillingly.

But Hei Fu said to him: "When Qin Shihuang was alive, he made many arrangements for his funeral."

"But Hu Hai and Zhao Gaoli Si, did you listen to him?"

"Did you and I leave according to his arrangement?"

"Is the direction of the world and the separation and separation of people's hearts as he wishes?"

Heifu spread his hands: "We can take care of the things before us, but how can we take care of the things behind us and our descendants? For generations to come, eternal prosperity? But as I said to you, how can there be an immortal dynasty in this world? , just let nature take its course..."

Fusu was silent, just looking at the stone carvings of Emperor Qin Shi Huang. On the cliff, hundreds of seal characters were still simple and powerful. On them were engraved what Qin Shi Emperor promised but failed to complete:

"The terrain is established, the common people are free of troubles, and the world is well cared for. Men enjoy their fields, and women cultivate their careers. Everything is in order. Benefit from all the properties, and come to the fields for a long time, no one will be uneasy!"

Now, this unfinished responsibility has been given to Heifu by his superiors...

Together with the fate of the empire, it is also in Heifu's hands.

Heifu was also staring at the seal carvings. He raised the wine bottle high and faced the immortal stone, as if that tall figure was already standing on the seaside:

"I miss the First Emperor."

Fusu's wine bottle met him.

"Me too……"

The two drank a lot, and then suddenly burst into laughter:

Heifu asked: "If the First Emperor were here, would he say this to us?"

Fusu smiled: "You must have slapped me in the face, scolded me, and driven me far away, so that I would not listen. And you, I am afraid, will be like Han Fei, who was given poisonous wine. Although my father regretted it afterwards , but you can only talk about it secretly, but on the surface you have to act cold and ruthless so that no one can see it..."

Heifu couldn't help laughing: "Yes, it will definitely be so."

But he sighed again:

"The dead can never be recovered. Remember what you should remember. In the future, we will not be able to make the same mistakes again."

Heifu bowed to Fusu as his last farewell:

"Go forward, Fusu, and keep moving forward."

"You and I, as successors, it's time to turn the page on the era left by the First Emperor!"

…

"That's right, it's time to turn the page."

Remembering what happened in Jieshi, after crossing Peishui, Fusu turned around and said to everyone:

"We have never left Da Qin!"

"But we are going to Haidong to build a new Qin with our own hands!"

They would cut down the overgrown weeds and vines, reclaim the land, and sow the seeds sent by Jiaodong merchants, plowing real ravines and borrowing real acres.

A new home will rise from the ground, and everything in this new country will be created by Fusu. He can finally make his own decisions about what should be inherited and what should be abandoned...

What will the new Qin look like?

It will definitely be different from the Qin Dynasty during the time of Emperor Qin Shihuang, and also different from the Qin under Hei Fu.

Looking at the three thousand faces that had experienced severe cold and wind and frost with him, but were now illuminated by the warm sun. Fusu put his hand on his chest, and the blood in his heart was beating just like when he was young!

"That will be what Young Master Fusu once told me when he was still alive..."

"His ideal Qin!"

…
